digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport / retry mechanism
propositions: DC rate-limit 429 responses are not honoured and propagate as hard failures on first occurrence, aborting read or mutation operations
rebar's retry policy does not handle HTTP 429 responses or Retry-After headers, causing integrations to fail on rate-limited instances

429 retries must be scoped to idempotent reads only; applying them to mutations via the shared _with_connection_retry choke point would reintroduce duplicate-issue failures because 429 can arrive after server-side write commencement
Retry-After header must be read from exc.response.headers with jitter applied first then clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S, not left as oversized or applied in wrong order

429 retry opt-in must default to OFF and reach all read call paths including get_comment_map's per-issue direct calls and _paged_search through _call_logged, preventing silent inheritance by future callers
